chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 249: Gouwa’s Terrible Idea – Romance and a Blowgun
chapter_meta_description: Gouwa and Lü Xiucai attempt to woo the women of the camp. One resorts to a "divine ability" with a blowgun. It goes about as well as you'd expect.
og_title: Showing Off – Dao Gui Yi Xian Chapter 249
og_description: Gouwa tries to impress the ladies with a blowgun trick. The results are… not what he planned.
twitter_title: Ch 249: Gouwa tries to flex and immediately regrets it 💀
twitter_description: A rare comic chapter! Gouwa and Lü Xiucai shoot their shot at romance—and one literally shoots a needle down his own throat.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-ranking Daoist cultivator title indicating profound attainment and spiritual realization; basically a certified master in cultivation hierarchy.
A region and group within the Dao-Twisted World; here, the local men are described as dark-skinned and short-statured, distinct from the protagonist’s group.
A supernatural power or miraculous skill, often gained through cultivation; Gouwa uses the term hyperbolically to inflate his own status.
